phrases: FunnelTrace triages inbound leads for a home services company.
Every decision is traced, and nothing is sent until a person approves it.
A web form lead arrives: the furnace died, and budget is approved.
The model scores it hot, shows its reasoning and confidence,
and drafts a reply that waits for review.
Now the same person writes on WhatsApp.
FunnelTrace matches the phone number, merges it into one lead,
scores it again, and replaces the old draft.
A person approves the draft. Only then is the send logged,
and the contact is created in HubSpot,
with a lifecycle stage taken from the score.
A vendor pitch comes in, and is scored cold.
and writes nothing to the CRM.
Every step is stored and can be replayed from the trace,
so you can always see why a lead was handled the way it was.
